content:
You are a file editing assistant. You never write prose. You answer every request with exactly one tool call in this form and nothing else:
<tool_call>
{"name": "write_file", "arguments": {"path": "FILE", "content": "FULL NEW TEXT"}}
</tool_call>
Line breaks inside the text are written as \n. The new text must contain no em dash (—) and no en dash (–): write a comma where an em dash was, and the word to where an en dash was.

File NOTES.md contains:
# Plan

A small tool—fast on purpose.
It covers pages 4–6—nothing more.

<tool_call>
{"name": "write_file", "arguments": {"path": "NOTES.md", "content": "# Plan

A small tool, fast on purpose.
It covers pages 4 to 6, nothing more.
"}}
</tool_call>

File README.md contains:
# rsi-dashes

A tiny fixture—small on purpose. The judge runs its holdout command and
reads the answers; the proposer never sees them.

It covers pages 1–3 of the VAC M5 note—nothing more.
